card.name: Just before fight and combat words
card.fires_on: Word starts or hyphen pieces where the next piece is likely 'fight', 'fought' or 'combat', as in cancer-fighting, hard-fought or combative. Also fires on military or battle settings.

modes.label: Fight compounds
modes.description: A hyphen or letter 'f' right before -fighting, -fought or fights, often about the body or disease.

modes.label: Combat word starts
modes.description: The start of 'combative' or a battle-related phrase where combat is implied.
modes.example: agitated<< comb>>ative state with ataxia and coma

modes.label: Military context
modes.description: Words in military or warrior descriptions where fighting is the theme.
